lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A structured array of high-luminance circular pixel clusters arranged in approximately four to five horizontal rows posterior to the branchial region, extending toward the caudal peduncle.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Subtle vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersecting the horizontal spot rows, creating a coordinate-like grid on the posterior lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal linear feature running along the upper third of the flank, exhibiting a sharp vertical luminance gradient with a bright superior edge and a shadowed inferior edge.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: A sparse distribution of approximately 8 to 12 high-luminance circular blobs visible within the silhouette of the first dorsal fin.
